S No  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  10.11.2023 WPCRL No. 1517 of 2023  Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
 Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. R.P. Singh, learned counsel for petitioners.
2. Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, learned Brief Holder for State of Uttarakhand.

3. By means of this Writ Petition, petitioners have sought following relief :-
"(i) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the direction to the respondent no. 2 and 3 to provide adequate protection to the petitioners, life and liberty is in danger because respondents no. 4 to 10 are frequently treating the petitioners of dire consequences."
4.
Learned State Counsel points out that respondent no. 4, who is wife of petitioner no. 3, has lodged an FIR, naming all petitioners as accused.

The said FIR is for offences punishable under Section 498A, 323 and 506 IPC, and is registered at Police Station Jhabrera on 27.10.2023.
5.
From the pleadings made in the Writ Petition, and also the submissions made by learned State Counsel, it appears to us that this is a pure and simple case of matrimonial dispute.
Even the petitioner has not disclosed the factum of FIR in Writ Petition.
Thus, we decline to interfere in the matter.
6. The petitioner is dismissed, with liberty to petitioners to approach the appropriate forum available to them.

(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.) 10.11.2023 10.11.2023 Rahul WPCRL/1517/2023 on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64884234/
